The Haarlem load forecast run has completed. Here are the results:

**Improvement over nomination: -1.3%**

The forecast model (TFT) achieved a MAE of 6310.8 compared to the nomination baseline of 6395.5. However, this improvement of **-1.3%** is **not statistically significant** — the 95% confidence interval crosses zero (ranging from -310.2 to 140.8), meaning we cannot reliably conclude the forecast is better than the nomination baseline.

The forecast was validated over 30 days (test period: 2024-12-22 to 2025-01-20) with 720 scored rows.
